The '''AgriSuub research facility''' was a research facility owned by [[AgriSuub]]. It was located in a cave near [[G'rinn Go city]] on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] and was one of the targets of [[Operation Thunderbolt]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
